Zuckerberg faces court scrutiny over Instagram's impact on teens

Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is facing potential legal challenges regarding the effects of Instagram on teenagers. Reports indicate he may have to appear in court to answer questions about the platform's impact. One report specifically mentions a 'pervert' reckoning in relation to AI smart glasses, while another focuses on the broader effects of Instagram on young users.
